messages.content: Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units.

function.name: calculate_park_area
function.description: Calculate the total area of a park based on the radius of its circular part. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circular part of the park. This is a float type value.

shape.description: The shape of the park. Default is 'circle'.

message.content:
The volume of a sphere with radius 3 units is  

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^{3}=\frac{4}{3}\pi(3)^{3}
   =\frac{4}{3}\pi(27)=36\pi\approx 113.10\text{ cubic units}.
\]
message.reasoning: The user wants to calculate the volume of a sphere with radius 3 units. The tool available is calculate_park_area which calculates area of a park based on radius of circular part. It expects radius, units, shape optional. But we need volume of sphere. There's no direct tool for volume. We can either compute manually or use the tool incorrectly? The instructions say: "If you do not have enough information to answer the user's request, ask clarifying question." We have enough info: radius 3 units. We can compute volume manually: V = (4/3)πr^3 = (4/3)*π*27 = 36π ≈ 113.097. So we can answer directly. There's no mention that we must use the tool. The tool is for park area. We don't need it. So we can just respond with the volume.
